frames.name: turn-030
frames.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset: single photorealistic turntable frame for a blouse portfolio. Input 1 back.png is the authoritative garment, framing, lighting and background reference; input 2 left.png is the side orientation reference; input 3 front.png is the front reference. Generate ONE 4:3 landscape photograph, same beige linen mannequin, same turquoise blouse, densely embroidered gold/silver floral vines, pearl edges and pink drop fringe. Camera fixed at chest height, same distance, mannequin centered on vertical axis, whole sleeves and hem inside frame, top neck and bottom waist cropped exactly as references. Same warm beige seamless background, fixed soft upper-left light, same exposure and color. Change ONLY mannequin yaw as described; keep the garment design and dimensions. No text, montage, extra garments or props. Yaw 30 degrees from the straight back toward the LEFT-PROFILE reference. Mostly back visible, back cutout center shifts toward the RIGHT of image, nearer embroidered sleeve on LEFT, far sleeve on RIGHT recedes. Intermediate angle only 30 degrees, NOT profile.
